# Franktech Enterprises

> Franktech Enterprises is a Nairobi, Kenya contractor specialising in interior design, fitting, partitioning, ceiling works, painting, masonry, tiling and general construction works.

Important facts:
- Services: interior design; fitting; partitioning; ceiling works; painting; masonry; tiling; general construction works.
